entries.name: tracking.maneuverability_noise
entries.rationale: TERMINOLOGY (M4 review): the interpretations are distinguished by the process-noise covariance MULTIPLIER. 'table_variance' -> multiplier 25 (sigma_w = 25 read as the acceleration-noise variance per Table II units and prose); 'equation_literal' -> multiplier 625 (= 25 squared, Eq. (3) as printed). The multiplier is applied to the structured Eq. (3) matrix directly; no further squaring occurs.
notes: Switchable: tracking.maneuverability_noise_interpretation in {'table_variance', 'equation_literal'}; both implemented, default documented, sensitivity to be tested (README section 4.1).
M3 review decision: 'table_variance' accepted as the default based on Table II units and prose; the default is NOT an author-confirmed correction of the paper.

entries.name: scanning.boltzmann_constant
entries.reference: SI 2019 exact definition
entries.rationale: Boltzmann constant k = 1.380649e-23 J/K; a standard physical constant, not a fitted parameter.

entries.name: tracking.initialization_policy
entries.rationale: DEGENERATE GEOMETRY: the paper initializes the estimate at the origin, where the range/azimuth measurement is singular (atan2(0, 0) undefined; measurement Jacobian degenerate). 'paper_zero_identity' reproduces the paper and is retained as a documented DIAGNOSTIC mode; it must never silently produce NaN/inf or an artificial Jacobian (an update at the origin raises MeasurementGeometryError).
notes: M3 review (instruction 3.3): the OPERATIONAL estimator uses the 'measurement_driven' policy, initializing from the first supplied observation plus explicitly configured velocity prior assumptions; the true state is never accessible to initialization.
No numerical initial-covariance values are attributed to the paper beyond x0 = 0, P0 = I_4.

entries.name: tracking.measurement_driven_initial_velocity
entries.reference: M3 review instruction 9 (no paper value)
entries.rationale: Velocity prior MEAN for measurement-driven initialization. Unresolved by default (None): initialization raises an informative error rather than inventing a default. Synthetic experiments supply values labeled as synthetic settings.

entries.name: tracking.measurement_driven_initial_velocity_variance
entries.reference: M3 review instruction 9 (no paper value)
entries.rationale: Velocity prior VARIANCE per axis (isotropic) for measurement-driven initialization; kept conceptually separate from the position uncertainty, which is derived from the first observation's covariance. Unresolved by default (None).

entries.name: tracking.covariance_update_method
entries.rationale: NUMERICAL STABILITY option: default 'paper_equation_13' applies Eq. (13) as printed, P_{t|t} = (I - K_t H_t) P_{t|t-1}. 'joseph' uses the form-preserving PSD update P = (I-KH) P (I-KH)^T + K R K^T, mathematically equivalent for the exact Kalman gain; equivalence is tested under valid numerical conditions.
notes: Posterior covariances are symmetrized against floating-point drift; covariance eigenvalues are never clipped to conceal defects.

entries.name: tracking.measurement_variance_semantics
entries.value: sigma^2_{r|theta,t} = sigma^2_{r|theta,0} / SNR_t (reference variance divided by linear SNR)
entries.reference: Z. Lu et al., IEEE ICC 2024, DOI 10.1109/ICC51166.2024.10622225; Eq. (6) and surrounding prose, p. 2787
entries.rationale: Owner-reviewed reading of Eq. (6). Evidence: (a) the paper prose directly below Eq. (6) states the variance DECREASES with longer dwell time or closer target 'according to equations (5) and (6)'; (b) SNR grows with dwell time and proximity per Eq. (5); (c) standard radar behaviour. Only the inverse reading satisfies all three.
notes: EXTRACTION HISTORY (settled): an early plain-text PDF extraction juxtaposed sigma^2_{.,0} and SNR_t on one line, producing a transient multiplication reading that contradicted the same paper's prose. Re-inspection with layout-aware extraction and the M3/M4 reviews identified this as a PDF-EXTRACTION ARTIFACT, not an unresolved mathematical ambiguity; the division semantics is the accepted paper reading and inverse-SNR scaling is NOT classified as a proposed deviation.
Implemented in radar_bo/radar/measurement_noise.py; requires the unresolved SNR0 (see tracking.reference_snr).

entries.name: optimization.acquisition_xi
entries.reference: M. Benzaghta et al., IEEE GLOBECOM 2023, DOI 10.1109/GLOBECOM54140.2023.10437768

entries.name: optimization.num_acquisition_candidates
entries.reference: M. Benzaghta et al., IEEE GLOBECOM 2023, DOI 10.1109/GLOBECOM54140.2023.10437768
entries.rationale: Acquisition candidate pool Nc = 500 per iteration.

entries.name: optimization.search_mode
entries.reference: M. Benzaghta et al., IEEE GLOBECOM 2023, DOI 10.1109/GLOBECOM54140.2023.10437768
entries.rationale: 'joint' is the default harness mode. Benzaghta et al. update one BS at a time (block-wise); 'alternating' mirrors that scheme and 'coordinate' is experimental.
notes: Adaptation, not reproduction: the paper's block-wise scheme is per-BS in their problem, not a generic harness mode.

entries.name: scanning.area_ratio_metric
entries.rationale: Eq. (21) implemented as a pure metric accepting a modeled detectable area and a strictly positive reference area; the ratio is NOT capped at one. Physical scanning calculations (Eqs. (16)-(20)) are NOT implemented: their parameters are unspecified (Table I).
notes: The paper's S0 remains unresolved (scanning.reference_area); the metric raises a parameter-resolution error rather than substituting a default.

entries.name: resource.remaining_scanning_time_convention
entries.rationale: Paper's own nonnegative remaining-time convention implemented verbatim in the resource accountant. The RAW time deficit is recorded alongside so an over-budget allocation is never silently made valid by the clipping; feasibility is judged separately by the constraint manager.
notes: M4: an allocation violating the proposed hard per-slot budget is reported infeasible; the Eq. (24) clipping does not rescue it.

entries.name: objective.eq23_aggregation
entries.rationale: Aggregation structure implemented by the objective evaluator over explicit component interfaces (tracking-cost provider, scanning-performance model). No GP training, acquisition optimization or BO candidate generation inside the evaluator.
notes: Single-slot objective; the paper's long-term discounted CMDP objective remains a recorded deviation (README section 14).

entries.name: resource.task_utility_weights
entries.reference: Z. Lu et al., IEEE ICC 2024, DOI 10.1109/ICC51166.2024.10622225; Eq. (23) weights w_n
entries.rationale: Per-task weights of the weighted tracking aggregate. None (default) means UNIFORM weights - a proposed software default, NOT a paper value. When supplied, weights must be finite, non-negative and match the task count.

entries.name: scanning.synthetic_linear_scanning_model
entries.rationale: SYNTHETIC scanning response S_det(tau_s) = k_synth * tau_s with gamma = S_det / S0_synth, for software integration tests ONLY. Constants are synthetic testing values, not radar physics; outputs must never be presented as validated coverage, detectable range or detection probability.
notes: Deterministic; documented numerical domain tau_s >= 0 finite; invalid inputs rejected.

entries.name: objective.randomness_policy
entries.rationale: Candidate evaluations rebuild the NumPy generator from the snapshot's CAPTURED state, so all candidates see identical random realizations and evaluation order cannot change outcomes. An independent-realizations policy would draw fresh entropy per evaluation; CRN is the documented M4 default and is recorded in every evaluation result.

entries.name: allocation.discrete_membership_policy
entries.rationale: Flat-vector dwell values must match the configured action set EXACTLY (tolerance 1e-12); near-members are rejected with the nearest member reported for diagnosis. No snapping, rounding, clipping or repair (M4 instruction 9).

entries.name: objective.snapshot_truth_exclusion
entries.rationale: The frozen snapshot carries posterior means/covariances, time, task ids and the captured generator state; TRUE simulated states are deliberately NOT copied into snapshots, so candidate-evaluation components cannot receive ground truth through the snapshot interface. Truth stays in the authoritative SimulationState.
notes: Snapshot integrity is content-hashed (sha256) and re-verified after every evaluation.

entries.name: objective.tracking_provider_m4_scope
entries.rationale: M4 tracking-cost retrieval uses the paper's Eq. (14) on the snapshot's CURRENT posteriors - allocation-independent by design. A candidate's effect on FUTURE tracking requires simulation advancement (M5+); a synthetic allocation-dependent provider exists for aggregation testing only (clearly labeled synthetic).

entries.name: optimization.num_initial_observations
entries.rationale: Initial space-filling design size; no paper default (README BOConfig proposes 30).

entries.name: optimization.evaluation_budget
entries.rationale: UNRESOLVED by design: no paper default; each experiment must set it explicitly (OptimizationConfig.ensure_ready fails clearly otherwise).

entries.name: environment.num_targets
entries.rationale: Fixed-population synthetic scenario (README 4.4); paper's population is not specified for reproduction.

entries.name: environment.random_seed
entries.rationale: Master seed for reproducibility; per-repetition seeds derived deterministically.

entries.name: experiment.repetitions
entries.rationale: Independent repetitions for statistical reporting; no paper default.

entries.name: resource.time_budget_semantics
entries.rationale: Default reproduces the paper's discounted cumulative budget. The proposed 'hard_per_slot' alternative is STRICTER (per-slot bound vs discounted cumulative bound); recorded as a deviation whenever used.
notes: M3 review (instruction 3.4): 'hard_per_slot' is reserved for the proposed BO configuration profile (M4+); no resource allocation or budget optimization is implemented in M3.
